_note: Steps for the 'Create the accounts' card, one block per platform (ids from platforms.json). Edit freely; no rebuild needed.
intro: Create every account on the phone you will post from. Give each account its own email address, and never sign in to your personal accounts in the same apps.

platforms.label: Instagram
steps: Sign up with the handle above (exact spelling, copy it)
Use the same handle as the name
Skip every "find friends" and contact sync prompt
Turn on "Upload at highest quality" (Settings → Media quality)

platforms.label: TikTok
steps: Sign up with an email address, not your phone number
Use the handle above as the username and the name (copy it)
Skip contact sync and "find friends" prompts
Turn Data Saver off (Settings and privacy → Data Saver) so videos upload in full quality

platforms.label: Facebook Page
steps: Create a Page and name it exactly like the handle above (copy it)
Don't invite friends, don't sync contacts
